description: Query time-series metric data from Datadog. Supports any Datadog metric query syntax (e.g., avg:system.cpu.user{host:myhost} by {env})

from.description: Start time as Unix epoch seconds

query.description: Datadog metric query. Example: avg:system.cpu.user{host:myhost} by {env}

to.description: End time as Unix epoch seconds

name: query-metrics
